_comment: Expected hashes of load-bearing runtime artifacts. This file is DURABLE
SOURCE EVIDENCE and is committed; the artifacts it describes are NOT.
rationale: raw pathology pixels, model binaries and generated databases
must never enter git. But reproducibility requires that a clean clone can
verify what it reconstructs. This file is that anchor: scripts/prepare_runtime.py
recomputes each hash and FAILS on mismatch; scripts/prepare_bake.py copies
only artifacts that pass; the Dockerfile refuses to build without them.
Regenerate deliberately after a model change, and say so in the commit.
Never regenerate to make a verification pass.
